title: ISA Descriptor

name.description: Identifier of the ISA; it must match the directory name. The generator defines `MIPP_<NAME>` when the ISA is selected, and adds `<NAME>` to the C++ `mipp::ISA` enum.

prefix.description: Prefix of the intrinsics, available in the templates as `isa.prefix` (e.g. `_mm256`).

size.description: Register size in bits (`128`, `256`, `512`), a macro for the sizes known at compile time only (`MIPP_SCALAR_SIZE`), or the list of supported sizes (SVE).

define.description: Preprocessor expression true when the compiler targets the ISA (e.g. `defined(__AVX__)`). It is the default condition of the native entries.

header_template.description: First lines of the generated `common.h` of the ISA (include guard, system headers), as a string or a list of lines. Jinja2 variables: `name`, `name_upper`.

hw_lmul.description: LMUL factors with native registers: register groups on RVV (`[1, 2, 4, 8, -2]`), `[1]` or `[]` elsewhere. `-2` enables the half-vectors (`d2`).

sw_lmul.description: LMUL factors built in software: a register of LMUL 2 is a pair of registers of LMUL 1, and so on (`[1, 2, 4, 8]`). `-2` builds the half-vectors on the registers of `sub_isa` (see `sw_ldiv_type`).

sw_ldiv_type.description: Strategy for a `-2` in `sw_lmul`. `sub_isa`: a half-vector is a full register of `sub_isa` (AVX `d2` uses the SSE registers and functions); it is the only implemented strategy.

sub_isa.description: Parent ISA (`sse` for `avx`, `avx` for `avx512`, `neon` for `sve`). It sets the detection precedence (an ISA is tested before its parent) and is added by `--simd-ext`. On its own, it does not make the implementations or the registers of the parent available.

info_names.description: Names printed by `mipp_info()`. The entries are tested in order and the first one whose `if` holds is used; the entry without `if` is the default and must be last. Omitted: the upper-cased `name`.

mipp_definitions.description: Preprocessor lines emitted for the users when the ISA is selected: feature macros such as `MIPP_AVX2`, `MIPP_BW`, `MIPP_64BIT`.

hw_mask.description: `true` when the masks have their own registers (AVX-512 `__mmask`, SVE and RVV predicates). The scalar fallback then converts the masks with `toreg` / `tomsk` instead of copying them.

hw_mask_requires_toreg.description: With `hw_mask`: the scalar fallback of a function with a mask argument or result depends on `toreg` and `tomsk`, so that the resolver emits them first.

hw_mask_is_bitfield.description: With `hw_mask`: a mask is an integer with one bit per lane (AVX-512). The scalar fallback converts it bit by bit.

hw_mask_extract_via_store.description: With `hw_mask`: the scalar fallback also depends on `store` to read a mask (RVV).

layout.description: For the ISAs whose register size is only known at compile time (RVV): templates of the size macros, of the fixed-size typedefs and of the `rvd` / `rvm` structures, used instead of the default ones.

size_symbol.description: Macro that gives the register size in bits (`__riscv_v_fixed_vlen`).

vlen_guard_template.description: Preprocessor condition (Jinja2: `width`, `abs_lmul`) under which the scalar fallback of a half-vector is valid.

defines_template.description: Template of the `MIPP_<ISA>_N_*` macros (number of lanes).

vector_typedef_template.description: Template of the fixed-size typedef of a data register.

mask_typedef_template.description: Template of the fixed-size typedef of a mask register.

datatypes.description: Supported datatypes, with their types and intrinsic suffixes.

additionalProperties.description: A datatype. The string fields can contain placeholders such as `{lsuffix}`, replaced for each LMUL by the values of `variables`.

data_ext.description: Suffix of the intrinsics for this datatype (`ps`, `epi32`, `f32`), available in the templates as `isa_dt_par.data_ext`.

data_ext_logi.description: Suffix of the bitwise intrinsics, when it differs (`si256` for integers).

data_ext_msk.description: Suffix of the intrinsics on masks, when it differs.

to_ptr.description: Element type for the pointer casts (`float32_t`).

if.description: Preprocessor condition under which the datatype is available (`defined(__aarch64__)` for NEON `float64`). It is added to the condition of every implementation entry of the datatype.

if_lmul.description: Condition per LMUL (`{"-2": "0"}`: no half-vector for this datatype), used instead of `if` for these LMUL values.

variables.description: Extra fields of the datatype, merged into it when the file is loaded: constants (`"width": "32"`) or maps from LMUL to value (`"lsuffix": {"1": "m1", "2": "m2", "-2": "mf2"}`) for the placeholders of the other fields. Also available in the templates.
